frames.timestampConfidence: Observed in the official player status while paused; approximate to the video frame.
frames.altText: Profile card with differently centered action rows and pink dashed empty-edge callouts.
frames.visibleFacts: Primary and secondary action rows have different widths. Pink callouts are in the source video; its Spanish subtitle remains.

frames.timestampConfidence: Observed in the official player status while paused; approximate to the video frame.
frames.altText: Revised profile card with a cover, social actions beside the avatar, one metric row and full-width primary actions.
frames.visibleFacts: Identity text shares a left edge; four metrics form one row. Yellow alignment callout and subtitle are from the video.

comparison.problem: The action rows leave uneven unused space; labels and values form competing alignments.
comparison.observedChanges: Identity text moves to a shared left edge, metrics become one row, social links sit beside the avatar, and primary actions span the content width.
comparison.mechanism: Shared edges and groups create a repeatable scan path.
comparison.transferWhen: Compact cards repeat identity, metrics and actions.
comparison.doNotGeneralize: The revision also adds a cover and changes spacing; this is not an isolated alignment experiment. Avoid hiding useful controls just to tidy the layout.
comparison.unverifiedOutcomes: Task speed, touch behavior and accessibility were not tested.

source.title: The 7 Color Mistakes that RUIN your UI Designs
source.creator: Kole Jain

frames.timestampConfidence: Observed in the official player status while paused; approximate to the video frame.
frames.altText: Open Cloud file grid with cyan, green, red and orange card surfaces and source-video contrast badges.
frames.visibleFacts: The four cards use different fills and pale labels. The Pass/Fail badges are the creator’s annotations, not measurements by this library.

frames.timestampConfidence: Observed in the official player status while paused; approximate to the video frame.
frames.altText: Same Open Cloud file grid with matching pale lavender cards, dark labels and colored file-type icons inside a yellow shell.
frames.visibleFacts: Repeated card surfaces now match; colored file-type icons and the yellow surrounding app remain.

comparison.problem: Four file cards use different saturated fills and pale labels, creating competing accents.
comparison.observedChanges: The same grid uses a shared pale lavender surface and dark labels; file-type icons retain color.
comparison.mechanism: Quieter repeated surfaces let labels and type markers carry the distinction.
comparison.transferWhen: Repeated content has equal priority and color has no separate status meaning.
comparison.doNotGeneralize: Do not remove useful brand or status color. Camera scale differs; compare color roles, not apparent type size. The displayed 3.11:1 Pass does not establish WCAG AA for normal-size text.
comparison.unverifiedOutcomes: No contrast ratio, usability or task outcome was independently measured.

examples.title: Separate the core form from optional controls

source.title: 5 SaaS UI/UX mistakes that SCREAM you Vibe Code
source.creator: Kole Jain

frames.timestampConfidence: Observed in the official player status while paused; approximate to the video frame.
frames.altText: Link creation in a tall right drawer, with advanced configuration and password entry displayed immediately.
frames.visibleFacts: Destination and title fields share the drawer with an expanded Advanced Options block and password input.

frames.timestampConfidence: Observed in the official player status while paused; approximate to the video frame.
frames.altText: Centered compact create-link modal with four core fields and Password, Targeting and Expiration actions.
frames.visibleFacts: The link list remains behind the modal. Short-link and description fields are added; optional configuration is represented by compact actions.

comparison.problem: The creation drawer displays an expanded advanced-options block beside destination and title fields.
comparison.observedChanges: The dialog is centered over the link list, adds short-link and description fields, and presents Password, Targeting and Expiration as separate actions.
comparison.mechanism: Optional controls occupy less initial space, making the main link details easier to distinguish.
comparison.transferWhen: Optional settings are uncommon and can be opened without losing entered data.
comparison.doNotGeneralize: The revision adds fields, changes container and grouping, and alters styling. A centered modal is not inherently better than a drawer. Required settings must remain visible; long or resumable tasks may need a page.
comparison.unverifiedOutcomes: The stills do not verify what the optional actions open, keyboard focus, validation, completion time or mobile behavior.
